page.div: The Lodge Kitchen already quoted this event, but an outside caterer is now selected. Its charges are no longer billed. Retire the kitchen quote to cancel the kitchen call-out (the kitchen manager is emailed), un-approve the menu items, and clear the charges. Then re-open the invoices and hit Update Invoices.

Build the quote of menu options for the customer — each line is guests x per-person. Pick a menu, or type a new name and choose "Create and edit" to add an entree, sides and price. Print the quote for the customer. (Actual billing comes from the kitchen's Menu Items once the customer's picks are approved — see the Approval tab.)

group.string: Event P&L — same totals as the printed report

field.name: x_pl_rental_income
field.help: Formula: locked agreed pre-tax price; otherwise the final-invoice snapshot; otherwise current Event Rental pre-tax. Source: Customer Pricing and Documents → Final Invoice. Venue payments settle this revenue; they do not add revenue again.

field.name: x_event_sales_income
field.help: Formula: Clover sales total minus Clover goods costs, excluding venue-payment item margins, plus any historical manually entered sales. Source: After Action → Clover and historical sales. Venue payments belong under Payments.

field.name: x_pl_total_income
field.help: Formula: Rental Revenue (pre-tax) + On-site Sales Margin (after goods). Source: this summary and After Action → Pull Clover Sales. Clover goods costs are already deducted.

field.name: x_total_costs
field.help: Formula: Event Costs → COGS for non-labor items + clocked paid wages + certified department gratuities + coordinator payout. Source: Event Costs, Timesheets, department call-out sheets and Coordinator Pay. POs excluded.

field.name: x_pl_net_total
field.help: Formula: Rental Revenue + On-site Sales Margin − Total Event Expenses. Source: this summary; identical to Print → Event P&L. Sales goods costs are already deducted by Clover. POs excluded.

field.name: x_total_paid
field.help: Formula: sum of recorded payments excluding write-offs, with the legacy deposit used when no payment log exists. Source: Payments → payment list / Deposit.

field.name: x_balance_remaining
field.help: Formula: customer grand total (agreed total when locked) − payments received − write-offs. Source: Customer Pricing and Payments. A payment reduces the balance, not event profit.

field.name: x_pl_coordinator_cost
field.help: Formula: sum of coordinator fee shares posted to event timecards; before posting, the configured Coordinator Fee if Pay Coordinator From This Event is checked. Source: Customer Pricing → Coordinator Pay and Timesheets. A pooled supplies fee is not a payout.

field.name: x_event_volunteer_hours
field.help: Formula: sum of worked hours on event-tagged volunteer timeclock entries. Source: Timesheets → event clock-ins. Volunteer = Volunteers department or no wage / paid contract category. Sign-ups and planned shifts are not clocked hours. These hours have $0 labor cost.

field.name: x_room_retail
field.help: Formula: sum of default room rates before reductions. Source: Rooms → selected rooms and room configuration.

field.name: x_room_income
field.help: Formula: sum of room booking subtotals charged before additional courtesy discount. Source: Rooms → rates, cleaning and service fees.

field.name: x_room_net
field.help: Formula: charged room subtotal minus additional courtesy room discount. Source: Rooms and Customer Pricing → Additional Discount.

field.name: x_eventcosts_total
field.help: Formula: sum of Quantity × Unit Cost (customer charge) on Event Costs. Source: Event Costs → charge lines. COGS is separate.

field.name: x_coordinator_fee
field.help: Formula: room default retail rate plus default cleaning/service fees, multiplied by coordinator percentage; or Lodge Settings fixed fee; or entered custom fee. Source: Rooms → room configuration, Lodge Settings → coordinator rule, Customer Pricing → Custom fee.

div.span: Pay the coordinator from this event
— fee of pooled to Event Supplies Fund (available )

button.name: action_contribute_coordinator_fund
button.help: Prepare this event’s contribution. Posting requires the event to be fully paid and prevents duplicate contributions.

field.name: x_discount_reason
field.placeholder: No additional discount

field.name: x_discount_pct
field.help: Formula: entered percentage × eligible room charge, capped to the available room amount. Source: Customer Pricing → Additional Discount. Does not reduce service charges.

field.name: x_discount_value
field.help: Formula: entered fixed courtesy room discount, capped to the available room charge. Source: Customer Pricing → Additional Discount.

field.name: x_discount_note
field.placeholder: Explain why this additional discount is being given (required)

div.div: Applies to the room only (a profit item) — not to any service we pay out.

field.name: x_total_billed
field.help: Formula: net room charges + Event Costs charges + Coordinator Fee, before tax. Source: Rooms, Event Costs and Customer Pricing. This is the live pricing calculation; the summary uses the agreed / invoiced price when available.

field.name: x_taxable_subtotal
field.help: Formula: net taxable room charges + Event Costs lines marked Taxable. Source: Rooms and Event Costs → Taxable.

field.name: x_nontaxable_subtotal
field.help: Formula: non-taxable Event Costs charges + Coordinator Fee. Source: Event Costs → Taxable unchecked and Customer Pricing → Coordinator Fee.

field.name: x_event_tax_amount
field.help: Formula: taxable subtotal × configured percentage tax rate. Source: Customer Pricing → Taxable and Lodge Settings → Event Tax. Not event revenue.

field.name: x_event_grand_total
field.help: Formula: live Event Rental pre-tax + sales tax. Source: Customer Pricing → Event Rental and Tax. Agreed Price governs billing when locked.

field.name: x_agreed_grand
field.help: Formula: pre-tax agreed amount + locked tax, captured when price is approved / locked. Source: Customer Pricing → Approve & Lock Price or Lock at an agreed total.

field.name: x_potential_revenue_charges
field.help: Formula: current chargeable total − agreed locked price, as calculated by price-lock rules. Source: Customer Pricing → Grand Total and Agreed Price. Not extra income unless separately agreed and invoiced.

button.name: action_customer_approve_pricing
button.help: Mark the customer's pricing approved and lock the contract price. After this, cost changes become Potential Revenue Charges, not customer billing. (A recorded deposit also locks it automatically.)

button.name: action_open_lock_price_wizard
button.help: For an already-booked event (e.g. a deposit was paid and later changes inflated the total): type the total the customer actually agreed to and lock at that figure. Suggests twice the deposit.

button.name: action_unlock_contract_price
button.confirm: Unlock the agreed price so billing follows the live total again? Use only to fix a mistaken lock.

field.name: x_quote_total
field.help: Formula: linked sale order total. Source: Customer Pricing → Quote & Invoice → quote link. May differ from the locked customer price.

field.name: x_balance_due
field.help: Formula: agreed pre-tax amount when locked, otherwise live pre-tax rental charges, minus logged payments (legacy deposit fallback). Source: Payments and Customer Pricing. Use Balance Remaining for the customer balance including tax / write-offs.

field.name: x_deposit_amount
field.help: Formula: recorded deposit amount (default based on configured deposit percentage). Source: Payments → Deposit and Lodge Settings → deposit percentage.

button.name: action_write_off_balance
button.help: Waive the remaining balance (a lodge-side courtesy, e.g. our mistake) — records a write-off, zeroes the balance, and credits it on the invoice. A reason is required.

div.span: Log each check / cash / card payment as it comes in. The balance updates and the final invoice credits what's been paid.

field.name: x_clover_info
field.help: A matching Clover point-of-sale payment was found around this date.

field.name: x_total_paid
field.help: Formula: sum of recorded payments excluding write-offs, with the legacy deposit used when no payment log exists. Source: Payments → payment list / Deposit.

field.name: x_writeoff_total
field.help: Formula: sum of payment rows whose method is Write-Off / Waived. Source: Payments → payment list.

field.name: x_balance_remaining
field.help: Formula: customer grand total (agreed total when locked) − payments received − write-offs. Source: Customer Pricing and Payments. A payment reduces the balance, not event profit.

field.name: x_cogs
field.help: Formula: non-labor Event Costs COGS + clocked paid wages + certified gratuities + coordinator payout. Source: Event Costs, Timesheets and department call-out sheets. Clover goods costs are already deducted from on-site margin.

field.name: x_total_costs
field.help: Formula: Event Costs → COGS for non-labor items + clocked paid wages + certified department gratuities + coordinator payout. Source: Event Costs, Timesheets, department call-out sheets and Coordinator Pay. POs excluded.

field.name: x_net_income
field.help: Formula: agreed / invoiced Rental Revenue (pre-tax) − Total Event Expenses. Source: Financials summary. Excludes on-site sales margin; Event Profit includes it.

field.name: x_event_sales_income
field.help: Formula: Clover sales total minus Clover goods costs, excluding venue-payment item margins, plus any historical manually entered sales. Source: After Action → Clover and historical sales. Venue payments belong under Payments.

field.name: x_pl_net_total
field.help: Formula: Rental Revenue + On-site Sales Margin − Total Event Expenses. Source: this summary; identical to Print → Event P&L. Sales goods costs are already deducted by Clover. POs excluded.

field.name: x_labor_billed
field.help: Formula: sum of certified-roster labor customer charges. Source: Event Costs → certified roster lines and department call-out sheets.

field.name: x_labor_actual_clocked
field.help: Formula: clocked event hours × W-2 wage or 1099 event rate; volunteers cost zero. Source: Timesheets → event clock-ins, employee Wage and department call-out rates. Excludes tips and coordinator fee.

field.name: x_labor_clocked_variance
field.help: Formula: billed roster labor − clocked labor pay. Source: Costs & Labor → Billed and Actual. Positive means labor charges exceed wages.

field.name: x_cat_catering
field.help: Formula: non-labor Event Costs COGS in Catering / Kitchen + corresponding clocked wages and certified tips; Other also includes coordinator payout. Source: Event Costs → Type / COGS, Timesheets and department call-out sheets. POs excluded.

field.name: x_cat_bar
field.help: Formula: non-labor Event Costs COGS in Bar + corresponding clocked wages and certified tips; Other also includes coordinator payout. Source: Event Costs → Type / COGS, Timesheets and department call-out sheets. POs excluded.

field.name: x_cat_event
field.help: Formula: non-labor Event Costs COGS in Event Services + corresponding clocked wages and certified tips; Other also includes coordinator payout. Source: Event Costs → Type / COGS, Timesheets and department call-out sheets. POs excluded.

field.name: x_cat_cleaning
field.help: Formula: non-labor Event Costs COGS in Cleaning + corresponding clocked wages and certified tips; Other also includes coordinator payout. Source: Event Costs → Type / COGS, Timesheets and department call-out sheets. POs excluded.

field.name: x_cat_other
field.help: Formula: non-labor Event Costs COGS in Other + corresponding clocked wages and certified tips; Other also includes coordinator payout. Source: Event Costs → Type / COGS, Timesheets and department call-out sheets. POs excluded.

page.name: event_tax_detail
page.invisible: x_is_member or x_is_elks_event or (not x_ubi_room_income and not x_ubi_tax_reserve)

field.name: x_ubi_room_income
field.help: Formula: room rental income eligible under current member/event rules. Source: Rooms and Event Details → member / event flags.

field.name: x_ubi_tax_reserve
field.help: Formula: eligible room income × Lodge Settings property-tax reserve percentage. Source: Tax & Reserves and Lodge Settings. Reserve shown separately from event operating expenses.

page.name: event_charity_disbursement

field.name: x_pl_net_total
field.help: Formula: agreed/invoiced rental revenue + on-site sales margin − event expenses. Source: Financials → Event P&L. Charity is allocated from proceeds after this calculation.

page.div: The requested fixed amount exceeds available proceeds by . This portion is not allocated. The charity receives only proceeds remaining after costs and the coordinator reserve.

Available proceeds are positive event profit after expenses and the coordinator fee reserved for the supplies fund. These amounts update as event totals change. This tab records the planned allocation; it does not issue payment or post a charity contribution.

field.name: x_charity_disbursement_notes

button.name: action_gratuity_disbursement_xlsx

page.name: event_after_action
page.div: This event is in the After-Action review. Add your notes below and review the Event P&L (button up top). A feedback survey is sent to the customer automatically.

group.string: Event Sales Income (on-site: bar / food / door)

field.name: x_sales_food

field.name: x_sales_other
field.help: Historical manual sales retained in P&L. New on-site sales come from Pull Clover Sales; venue payments belong under Financials → Payments.

field.name: x_sales_notes
field.placeholder: e.g. Clover NET batch 9/17, cash drawer count...

div.span: Pulls the top items and net sales for the event window (+/- the buffer in Lodge Settings), excluding venue-payment items, and fills Clover into Event Sales Income.

page.div: Review these after the event. Completing the event automatically marks all four closeout steps done; recorded financial data stays unchanged.
